description: Turn Stone into Pebbles using a Stonecutter, then craft them back into Cobblestone. A lightweight utility mod for Minecraft 1.21.4 (Fabric)

mods.name: RP-StoneCobbler
mods.description: Turns stone into pebbles via stonecutter, then recombine to cobblestone!

releases.notes:
Turns stone into pebbles via stonecutter, then recombine to cobblestone!

## 🧱 Features
- Add "Pebble" item
- Stone can be turned into pebbles via stonecutter
- 4 pebbles (shaped) → 1 cobblestone

## 📦 Files
- `stonecobbler-1.0.0.jar`: Main mod file (install this)
- `stonecobbler-1.0.0-sources.jar`: Source code (for developers)

## 🧩 Compatibility
- Minecraft: 1.21.4
- Fabric Loader: 0.16.10+
- Java 21+
